name: Vestiges of the Dead God
description:
creator: Andrew E. Brereton
date: 2021-12-11
twitter: @aebrer
website: aebrer.xyz
platform: Pico-8, Lua

Press Z to save a gif of the last 16 seconds. This is meant to be a perfect loop, but you might have to wait up to a minute first to let your piece reach a stable equilibrium that actually loops.

Press X to save a high-resolution screenshot.
